name: Musa
source:
An employee of Wan-Shin Fabric owned by Zi-Jin. Also Melati's neighbor. Musa spends all of his free time with his indie band.

He was once an optimistic person, but changed after his brother's death.

"Melati, I hope you remember what I said. Its for your own good."

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
